# credence

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:credence`](gmeow-credence.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/credence>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/epistemics`](../../slices/epistemics.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A graded degree-of-belief in the closed interval [0,1], attached to a [`DoxasticState`](../classes/gmeow-DoxasticState.md). Non-functional: an agent's credence may be reported by multiple sources or updated over time, and those reports coexist ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)). Distinct from [`gmeow:confidence`](gmeow-confidence.md) (our certainty about a statement, in the provenance/statement layer) and from [`claimModality`](gmeow-claimModality.md) (qualitative standpoint belief value on the linked [`StandpointClaim`](../classes/gmeow-StandpointClaim.md)).

## Structure

**Property shape:** datatype property; [`gmeow:DoxasticState`](../classes/gmeow-DoxasticState.md) -> [`xsd:decimal`](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#decimal)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:credence`](gmeow-credence.md) from [`gmeow:DoxasticState`](../classes/gmeow-DoxasticState.md) to [`xsd:decimal`](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#decimal) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

### Belief Revision

- **Source:** [`slices/core/epistemics/examples/belief-revision.ttl`](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/slices/core/epistemics/examples/belief-revision.ttl)
- **Examples catalog:** [open in catalog](../../examples/index.md#example-slices-core-epistemics-examples-belief-revision)#example-slices-core-epistemics-examples-belief-revision

```turtle
@prefix gmeow: <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/> .
@prefix ex:    <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/examples/epistemics/> .
@prefix rdfs:  <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .
@prefix xsd:   <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> .



# --- Original belief (high credence, unequivocal) -----------------------------
ex:originalBelief a gmeow:DoxasticState ;
    rdfs:label "original belief: the printer is broken"@en ;
    gmeow:epistemicAgent ex:operator ;
    gmeow:doxasticContent ex:propPrinterBroken ;
    gmeow:credence "0.92"^^xsd:decimal ;
    gmeow:doxasticClaim ex:originalClaim .

# --- Revised belief (lower credence, probable) --------------------------------
ex:revisedBelief a gmeow:DoxasticState ;
    rdfs:label "revised belief: printer may be broken"@en ;
    gmeow:epistemicAgent ex:operator ;
    gmeow:doxasticContent ex:propPrinterBroken ;
    gmeow:credence "0.35"^^xsd:decimal ;
    gmeow:doxasticClaim ex:revisedClaim .
```

### Flagship Epistemic Ledger

- **Source:** [`slices/core/epistemics/examples/flagship-epistemic-ledger.ttl`](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/slices/core/epistemics/examples/flagship-epistemic-ledger.ttl)
- **Examples catalog:** [open in catalog](../../examples/index.md#example-slices-core-epistemics-examples-flagship-epistemic-ledger)#example-slices-core-epistemics-examples-flagship-epistemic-ledger

```turtle
@prefix gmeow: <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/> .
@prefix ex:    <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/examples/epistemics/flagship/> .
@prefix rdfs:  <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .
@prefix xsd:   <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> .



# --- Original credence-weighted belief (operator) --------------------------------
ex:opBeliefOriginal a gmeow:DoxasticState ;
    rdfs:label "original belief: LLM recalled the meeting date correctly"@en ;
    gmeow:epistemicAgent ex:operator ;
    gmeow:doxasticContent ex:propRecall ;
    gmeow:doxasticClaim ex:opClaimOriginal ;
    gmeow:credence "0.85"^^xsd:decimal ;
    gmeow:justifiedBy ex:evidenceSpan1 .

# --- Revised belief after a defeater ---------------------------------------------
ex:opBeliefRevised a gmeow:DoxasticState ;
    rdfs:label "revised belief: LLM probably misremembered the meeting date"@en ;
    gmeow:epistemicAgent ex:operator ;
    gmeow:doxasticContent ex:propRecall ;
    gmeow:doxasticClaim ex:opClaimRevised ;
    gmeow:credence "0.30"^^xsd:decimal .
```

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:DoxasticState`](../classes/gmeow-DoxasticState.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to record a numeric degree-of-belief on a reified [`DoxasticState`](../classes/gmeow-DoxasticState.md) when graded strength is itself first-class.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for the flat [`gmeow:believes`](gmeow-believes.md) spine (use [`gmeow:standpointModality`](gmeow-standpointModality.md) on the statement instead) and avoid conflating it with [`gmeow:confidence`](gmeow-confidence.md) or [`gmeow:claimModality`](gmeow-claimModality.md).

### How to use

- Attach one or more [xsd:decimal](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#decimal) values in [0,1] to a [`DoxasticState`](../classes/gmeow-DoxasticState.md); pair with [`doxasticClaim`](gmeow-doxasticClaim.md) carrying [`claimModality`](gmeow-claimModality.md) for the qualitative side.

### Examples

- ex:aliceBelievesRound [`gmeow:credence`](gmeow-credence.md) "0.92"^^[xsd:decimal.](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#decimal.)
